articles.headline: Veteran defender Nicolás Otamendi signs with boyhood club River Plate
articles.description: Veteran defender Nicolás Otamendi has signed a contract with River Plate to return to the Argentine league as a free agent from Benfica.

articles.headline: Boca Juniors plans Bombonera expansion to 80,000 seats
articles.description: After River Plate presented a project to roof its Monumental Stadium, arch-rival Boca Juniors announced it will expand the capacity of La Bombonera in the stadium's biggest ever makeover.

articles.headline: Argentine clubs to strike in response to Tapia travel ban
articles.description: Professional clubs in Argentina have agreed to strike from March 5-8 in protest against what they consider judicial persecution of Argentine Football Association president Claudio Tapia.

articles.headline: River Plate expanding iconic Monumental to hold 101,000 fans
articles.description: River Plate has announced a massive expansion of the Monumental Stadium, increasing its capacity to 101,000 spectators in a move that will make it one of the largest soccer venues in the world.

images.name: Monumental stadium [1296x729]
images.caption: River Plate is set to launch its second major renovation of the Monumental in eight years, expanding capacity to over 101,000 and adding a state-of-the-art roof to cover the stands.

articles.headline: World's weirdest soccer leagues: 8 champions? Points for losing?
articles.description: What happens when leagues shun the traditional round-robin format? Here's some of the weird and wonderful ways titles are won around the world.

articles.headline: Rosario Central, Ángel Di María handed surprise Argentine title
